A '''thermic baster''' was a type of cooking tool.<ref name="Inside" /> The device had an opening in the top portion of the front face of its [[Color/Legends|cream]]-colored body with two silver colored utensils inside. There were two square red lights located below the opening on the front face.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> There was a thermic baster mounted on the wall above a counter in the kitchen of the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] in the [[Skywalker home/Legends|home]] where she and her [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], lived on [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] hosted a group of offworlders during a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]<ref name="Inside" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A thermic baster appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> It was identified in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
